assembly: For each entry, concatenate common + '\nSubject: ' + subject. Refinements below replace the initial result for their item. Center on a square transparent canvas without changing aspect ratio, then export to 16x16 RGBA using nearest-neighbor sampling and preserve the generated alpha.
common: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production Minecraft inventory item PNG for the Italian's Delight mod, matching vanilla Minecraft and Farmer's Delight. Create exactly ONE inventory sprite, no sheet. Strict pixel art on an EXACT logical 16 by 16 square pixel grid, designed to remain clear at 16x16. Return native 16x16 if possible, otherwise an exact nearest-neighbor enlargement of this 16x16 grid. Every visible pixel must align to this coarse grid: no subpixels, no fine details, no antialiasing, no smooth gradients. Fully transparent alpha background, including around the silhouette; no painted background or checkerboard. Subject centered with 1 to 2 logical pixels of transparent margin, fills about 12x12 pixels. Limited palette, about 5-8 flat colors; creamy ivory highlights, desaturated beige shadows for dairy, warm brown for wooden bowls, upper-left light. Soft material-colored stepped outlines, no thick black outline. Slight three-quarter inventory view showing top and front; simple readable silhouette. No text, labels, lettering, logos, watermark, decorative props, plate unless requested, cast shadow, scenery, or lighting effects.

A shallow warm brown wooden Minecraft bowl containing a dense smooth pale cream mascarpone mound with a broad small folded peak. Bowl uses just dark brown underside, medium brown front and ochre rim, matching a vanilla food bowl. The mascarpone has no granules or liquid pool.

A shallow warm brown wooden Minecraft bowl filled with level, smooth white dairy cream, a flat ivory oval surface inside the visible ochre rim. Dark brown underside, medium brown front. Contents are liquid cream: no tall mound, no peak, no granules.

A shallow warm brown wooden Minecraft bowl holding a heaped mound of white ricotta with a few distinct square curd granules and irregular lumpy crest. Dark brown underside, medium brown front, ochre rim. Ivory highlights with pale gray-beige tiny grain shadows; visibly grainier and taller than smooth cream.

One small irregular clump of blue-green cheese starter culture on a tiny beige porous crumb base. A compact jagged silhouette with 3-4 distinct desaturated teal, blue-gray and pale sage patches; beige underside. This is a loose craftable ingredient, NOT a bottle, jar, bowl, mushroom or cheese wheel. Readable simple granular clump.

One whole broad squat cylindrical wheel of fresh Parmigiano Reggiano, ivory and pale buttery yellow. Flat elliptical top, straight low side wall, ratio about 12 pixels wide to 8 high. Smooth pale fresh surface with no aged brown rind. Intact wheel, no missing wedge, holes, stamps or wrapping.

One whole broad squat cylindrical wheel of aged Parmigiano Reggiano, rich straw-gold hard rind, light golden top and ochre lower side. Flat elliptical top, straight low side wall, about 12 pixels wide to 8 high. Tiny darker rind accents; intact wheel, no missing wedge, holes, stamps or text.

A small low heap of grated Parmigiano Reggiano with 3 loose square flakes near the base. Warm straw-yellow pale gold shavings, small squared steps and ivory highlights, ochre lower edges. Loose grated cheese, no bowl or plate; coarse silhouette readable in 16x16.

One whole taller cylindrical wheel of fresh Pecorino Romano, chalky ivory-white, pale cool gray-beige lower-right shadow. Flat elliptical top, relatively tall straight side wall, about 10 pixels wide and 10 high. Smooth pale fresh rind, intact wheel, no missing wedge, holes, stamping or labels.

One whole taller cylindrical wheel of aged Pecorino Romano. Chalky pale ivory top, slightly darker gray-taupe rind on its tall straight side, with a narrow pale rim. About 10 pixels wide and 10 high. Dry firm rind indicated by few broad gray-beige pixels. Intact wheel, no cut wedge or holes. Clearly cooler, paler and taller than golden Parmesan.

One thick triangular wedge of Pecorino Romano with a chalky ivory-white cut face and gray-taupe hard rind along the tall outer back edge. Clear pointed triangular tip, compact high profile, cool cream highlight. No blue mold, holes, bowl or golden orange rind.

A small low heap of grated Pecorino Romano, chalky white and cool ivory square crumbs with gray-beige base shadows and 3 loose square flakes. Loose grated cheese, no bowl, plate or garnish. Clearly whiter and cooler than golden grated Parmesan; simple compact silhouette.

One whole small squat cylindrical wheel of fresh Gorgonzola before blue mold maturation, pale ivory-white top, creamy light-gray side. Broad rounded elliptical top and soft rounded side edges. One whole squat cylindrical wheel of matured Gorgonzola, creamy ivory rind with a few distinct sparse blue-green mold spots on the top and side, muted gray-beige shaded bottom. One Minecraft-style metal bucket filled with pale straw-yellow slightly greenish whey visible at the open top, silver-gray angular rim and body, dark charcoal lower edge, tiny gray handle pixels at top corners. refinements.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. The attached PNG is the fresh Parmigiano cheese wheel sprite and the edit target. Create its aged Parmigiano variant. Preserve EXACTLY its square canvas, fully transparent background and alpha silhouette, simple cylindrical shape, camera angle, position and coarse pixel-art style. Change ONLY the cheese colors: hard rind in muted straw-gold, light warm golden top, ochre shaded lower side, with at most a few broad darker rind pixels. Keep the intact wheel and understated vanilla Minecraft inventory appearance. No added details outside the wheel, NO glow, NO halo, NO background, NO shadow, NO holes, NO realistic lighting, NO fine speckles, no text. This must remain an isolated Minecraft item sprite on transparent alpha, ready to reduce to 16x16 pixels.

Use case: precise-object-edit. The attached PNG is the matured Gorgonzola wheel inventory sprite and is the edit target. Produce the FRESH pre-maturation variant. Preserve EXACTLY the square canvas, transparent alpha background, wheel silhouette, size, position, perspective and coarse Minecraft pixel style. Change only the maturation colors: remove all teal-blue-green mold spots and veins, replacing them with clean pale ivory, cream and light gray-beige wheel surface. It should be a smooth intact fresh cheese wheel, with no holes or mold pattern. Retain simple top-left light and subtle side shading. No glow, halo, background, cast shadow, labels, props, letters or extra texture. Fully transparent background. The result will be exported to a 16x16 inventory sprite.

additions.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Minecraft / Farmer's Delight inventory tool sprite. The attached user photo is the shape reference: a FLAT handheld stainless-steel cheese grater, one elongated rectangular perforated silver plate, slightly rounded corners, integrated oblong hand opening at the top. Create a single crisp pixel-art item icon on a truly transparent background, including transparency through the hand opening. NOT a box grater, NOT a knife, no long separate wooden or plastic handle. No cheese or other objects from the photo. Logical 16 by 16 pixel sprite, deliberately very coarse Minecraft pixels enlarged without smoothing. Strong recognizable flat metal outline with dark gray edging, silver-gray face, a few bright rim highlights and 6-10 sparse dark grating holes in rows. Show the wide perforated face clearly in near frontal view, on the Minecraft tool diagonal with the perforated blade toward upper right and the integrated open grip toward lower left, ready to be held by its grip in the right hand. Fit the whole grater within the square canvas with 1 logical pixel transparent margin. Flat vanilla pixel-art shading using 5-7 opaque colors, no gradients, no antialiasing, no photorealism, no scene, no ground shadow, no text, no grid. Output only the isolated tool sprite on actual alpha transparency.
additions.assembly: Nearest-neighbor downsampling to 16x16 RGBA; generated alpha preserved.
